title: Sebi orders Avadhut Sathe, academy to refund Rs 546 crore

Avadhut Sathe and his academy provided unregistered investment advisory services under the pretext of education. The regulator found that misleading testimonials were circulated while concealing overall trading losses. A penalty of ₹11.5 crore was imposed on Sathe and the academy for their actions.

title: Anthropic IPO: What should investors consider when valuing the AI company? Aswath Damodaran explains
description: Anthropic is on track for an IPO expected in mid-November, reporting impressive revenues of $16.3 billion. However, the company faces a staggering net loss of over $80 billion for the year. Valuation expert Aswath Damodaran warns that IPO investor metrics can be erratic and heavily influenced by market sentiment. As Anthropic navigates an evolving business model, investors are advised to look beyond venture capital evaluations for a clearer understanding.
